angle.hook: Euro Truck Simulator 2 now lets players swap the truck for a licensed coach: the Coaches DLC is out on Steam
angle.why_now: SCS Software released the DLC on 12 Nov 2026 (blog post 10:00 CET, Steam page release date 12 Nov); the Steam UAE store lists it at AED 46.99
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf PC players of the long-running trucking sim get passenger jobs and three licensed coaches for AED 46.99; Arabic is not among the Steam languages
angle.payoff: Quick, Contract and Tourist jobs, three licensed coaches, AED 46.99 on the UAE store
